name: render-all-views-simple
description: Batch render of all saved camera views (PARITY-BATCHRENDER). Verifies the batchRender flag is OFF in Simple and ON in Pro; that the View menu's saved-views section shows 'Render all views' once views exist (Pro); and that running renderAllSavedViews flies through each saved view and fires the progress + success toasts (live scene -> applyView -> captureCanvasPng -> download).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).
